answer: Require every new identity to import a work record from another network, checked against that network's ledger in a shared atlas. An ocean of fresh accounts means nothing without one anchored record behind it; a knoll of real history is the admission ticket. Forging an import bans the identity 20 epochs and burns its fee, while the verifier that signed a fake loses its license and escrow. Verification costs 18,000 POA per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 18,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays 18,000 once. Limitation: a genuine newcomer with no history anywhere is locked out until it builds one.
